name: arcade
description: 8-bit arcade screens: deep night-violet slides with sparse pixel stars and a dithered floor that holds the footer like a status bar, Press Start 2P caps headlines with one yellow word on a hot-pink drop, Chakra Petch reading copy, VT323 for labels and terminal lines, and a segmented lime power bar for progress. Visuals become native game UI: pixel-framed windows, heart HUDs, inventory slots, stepped flow paths and RPG dialog boxes. The CTA is a yellow screen.
source: Free theme, built from scratch for an off-brand retro-game look, October 2026. No template photos.
best_for: gaming, mods, tools and dev-culture posts

texture: none (pixel stars and the dithered floor are the texture)
slide_fields: fill: true turns any slide into a yellow screen (default only on the CTA)
visual tilt is ignored: pixel art stays square to the grid
